conventions: loopback only: the socket is bound to 127.0.0.1 and never to 0.0.0.0
read-only: no endpoint mutates world or player state
units are part of the field name (_ms, _bytes, _per_s)
null means not collected yet; never assume 0
top-N is computed server-side; pass top=N to change size
